sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 5

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 5:1
items.html: On the second day, the redness within the fetus is corrected, meaning the inclusion of Malchut and its coarseness in every single Sefira of ZA, whereby the phase of the left line was made there in every Sefira, which was done through the illumination of the five Gevurot of Ima. (Item 6).
